corrections.subject: docs/GAMEPLAY_SETTINGS.md 'One correction to record'
corrections.was: the authored key names PumpRepairMultiplier (+3c8h) and FireRepairMultiplier (+3cch) are crossed against the code's use of them
corrections.is: they are not crossed. +3c8h PumpRepairMultiplier divides the water step's damage and +3cch FireRepairMultiplier divides the fire step's, which is exactly what the shipped comments say ('the water gives this many times less damage over time' and 'the fire gives this many times less damage over time'). The crossed pair is the two Ghidra function names. Both values are 3 in the installed file, so no shipped run is affected either way.
corrections.evidence: the two rows above; the consumer bodies 0093c120-0093c20b and 0093c210-0093c2fb were read for this packet
